info.description:
Read-only API for Rust game data, served as static JSON files from a CDN.
Dynamic filtering and search are available through an optional Cloudflare Worker.

Unofficial project, not affiliated with Facepunch. Item icons are mirrored locally.
info.summary: Static API for Rust game data (dataset 1099 items).
info.title: Rust API (unofficial)
